entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.dialogueText: "Alright, let's not dawdle any longer. Time to get down to business."

entries.dialogueText: "As do I, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Iturriaga exploited his exclusive access to tamper with inventory records, concealing the disappearance of vital materials."

entries.dialogueText: "This is excellent news. What of his present whereabouts?"

entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your candor, Your Majesty. I share your concern and will work tirelessly to rebuild the respect our family once commanded."

entries.dialogueText: "But I'm proud to serve once more."

entries.dialogueText: Lucita frowned in faux concern.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "You have my deepest apologies, Your Majesty. We assumed that your priority was Rizia's national security and acted accordingly."

entries.dialogueText: "You won't hear it. You'll see it."

entries.dialogueText: “Where have you been?”

entries.dialogueText: “I'll believe that when I hear it, Duchess."

entries.dialogueText: "Lucita. So glad you could finally join us. I was beginning to think you got lost in the maze of palace corridors."

entries.dialogueText: "Suffice it to say we've had a breakthrough in the Friendship Day bombing case. A big one."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: "“Thank you. Gentlemen?""
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you. Gentlemen?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "It won't. I can promise you that."

entries.dialogueText: "I promise it won't."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes, the promise of a better future is all that's needed to turn the tide."
